content: Our corpus covers a broad range of news including news around earnings dates and complements the 10-K reports content. As an illustration, the headlines “Walmart warns that strong U.S. dollar will cost $15B in sales” and “Procter & Gamble Co raises FY organic sales growth forecast after sales beat” describe the company financial conditions and performance from the management point of view – these are also typical content present in Section 7 of the 10-K reports.
